key_insight: Geometric nonlinearity alone creates a distinct near-crack-tip nonlinear zone with a physical length scale that grows quadratically with the stress intensity factor.
engineering_relevance: This provides a clean baseline for predicting fracture in highly deformable soft solids and for separating kinematic effects from true constitutive nonlinearity.
method: Modelled a mode-I, plane-strain crack in a compressible St. Venant-Kirchhoff solid.
Postprocessed crack-tip opening displacement (CTOD) profiles to identify deviation from linear elastic fracture mechanics.
Used matched asymptotics to derive the nonlinear zone size \u03bb_nl and its scaling with K_I.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports asymptotic analytical solutions and a robust CTOD-based analysis showing a nonlinear near-tip regime governed by Poisson's ratio.
watch_item: The conclusions are based on an idealized constitutive model without material nonlinearity, so extension to real soft solids will require additional validation.
paper_title: Crack-Tip Opening as a Probe for Length-Scale Separation in Geometrically Nonlinear Solids
